# Expression Function Reference

<!-- Generated by ExpressionReference (./gradlew :sim-harness:expressionReference). Do not edit. -->

Functions available in VS expressions: advertisement `score` and `condition` fields, effects and `/vs expr eval`. The syntax is described in [ARCHITECTURE.md §9](ARCHITECTURE.md#9-vs-expression-language). Addons add their own functions with `SimRegistrar.function`.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `abs(number) -> number` | Absolute value. |
| `clamp(number, number, number) -> number` | `clamp(x, lo, hi)`: x limited to the range [lo, hi]. |
| `day() -> number` | Days since the sim started. |
| `deficit(string) -> number` | `deficit('hunger')`: 100 minus the need. |
| `distance() -> number` | Distance in blocks from the actor's position to the venue. |
| `floor(number) -> number` | Rounds down to a whole number. |
| `friends_here() -> number` | How many of the actor's friends are at the venue now. |
| `has_actor() -> bool` | True when the expression has an actor (a villager or player). |
| `has_job() -> bool` | True when the actor is employed. |
| `has_venue() -> bool` | True when the expression has a venue (a building). |
| `hour() -> number` | Hour of the sim day as a fraction, 0 to 24 (tick 0 is 06:00). |
| `is_home() -> bool` | True when the venue is the actor's home. |
| `is_workplace() -> bool` | True when the venue is the actor's workplace. |
| `max(number, number) -> number` | The larger of two numbers. |
| `min(number, number) -> number` | The smaller of two numbers. |
| `mood() -> number` | The actor's mood: the sum of their memories' current effects. |
| `need(string) -> number` | `need('hunger')`: the actor's need, 0 (desperate) to 100 (satisfied). |
| `random() -> number` | A deterministic pseudo-random number in [0, 1) for this actor, venue and time. |
| `rivals_here() -> number` | How many of the actor's rivals are at the venue now. |
| `stat(string) -> number` | `stat('id')`: the actor's value of a stat, after modifiers. |
| `stock(string) -> number` | `stock('good')`: how many of a good the venue has. |
| `trait(string) -> number` | `trait('kindness')`: a personality trait, 0 to 1. |
